amount.description: Fixed amount, or a 0–100 percentage when isPercentage is true.

numberOfInstallments.description: Split the total into this many equal monthly installments.

installmentAmount.description: Fixed monthly installment amount (the last one absorbs any remainder).

startDate.description: Due date of the first installment; each following one is +1 month.
